name: Seraph of the Sword
oracle_text:
Flying
Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to this creature.

needs.what: a combat-only restriction on the `prevent_damage` static with `prevent_all` -- a total damage shield on `affects: {self_only: true}` that applies only when the damage event is combat damage, leaving noncombat damage (burn, fight, ping) to be dealt normally
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` static's `prevent_all` (read by characteristics.prevents_all_damage) prevents ALL damage with no combat test, which would make the Seraph immune to burn and fight too. `combat_only` exists in ability_keys but the loader rejects it on anything but `replace_damage`. `replace_damage` with combat_only and a 0 multiplier would be a replacement, not a prevention (no DAMAGE_PREVENTED, wrong under 'damage can't be prevented'), and protection also stops blocking/targeting.
